title: Mutation: Stale Revision Reference

revision_history.author: traceability_engineer
revision_history.description: Reconciled the expectation with the rule this scenario declares. declared detector 'Revision consistency checker (stale revision)' -> rule id 'revision_consistency_checker'; expected category verification -> consistency; expected description de-duplicated: it had been copy-pasted from SCN-MUT-020 and did not describe this scenario's defect. Severity and category are the rule's values and are authoritative; the rule was not changed to fit this fixture. severity unchanged. The category was verification only because the expectation had been copy-pasted from another scenario; the rule emits consistency, and a current revision that does not appear in the record's own revision history is a consistency defect, not a statement about verification. The rule is authoritative.The scenario's injected defect, its affected artifacts and its declared detector rule are unchanged. This expectation had never been checked: the scenario harness matched any finding of the right severity on the right artifact id, so a standing finding on the same artifact satisfied it. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000032.

patch.description: Change artifact revision to stale value that doesn't match current revision

trigger: Corpus validation check on revision consistency
impact_paths: Traceability links referencing FB2-SAF-FSR-000001 revision 1 now point to stale revision
Impact analysis for this artifact will use stale data
